shadowTaxonomy.title: Shadow taxonomy
shadowTaxonomy.subtitle: Elements the AI review proposed when it confirmed a real TEF entry is genuinely missing — always preliminary until promoted or rejected here. Never used by the primary matching pass; the real TEF taxonomy always gets first crack at a match.
shadowTaxonomy.removeAllDescription: This permanently deletes every shadow element, preliminary, promoted, or rejected. Any shift pointing at one just loses that reference -- nothing else is touched. Use this after a matching/review fix makes the existing list stale, before rerunning.
shadowTaxonomy.qualitySpecificHint: Tied to one measurable activity — no narrowing needed.
shadowTaxonomy.qualityNarrowableHint: A real mechanism, but needed real narrowing to get here — worth a human look.
shadowTaxonomy.qualityVagueHint: Couldn't be pinned to one specific activity or operational unit even after trying.
shadowTaxonomy.mergeReviewDescription: Each group below looks like the same real-world gap, worded differently. Nothing physically moves or gets deleted -- a merged element keeps its own data and can be unlinked later. Uncheck any element that doesn't belong, or skip a whole group.
shadowTaxonomy.mergeReviewCanonicalHint: Kept as-is -- everything else in this group merges into it
shadowTaxonomy.realOverlapReviewTitle: Possible overlaps with the real taxonomy
shadowTaxonomy.realOverlapReviewDescription: Each pair below is flagged as possibly covering the same real-world mechanism as an existing TEF entry -- deliberately conservative, so a flag can still be wrong (e.g. the real entry might only be one narrower example of a broader gap). Nothing is checked by default. Review the reasoning and check only the ones you agree with.
shadowTaxonomy.realOverlapCandidatesError: Failed to check against the real taxonomy
shadowTaxonomy.realOverlapDoneTitle: Replaced {{count}} shadow element(s) with their real TEF match
shadowTaxonomy.realOverlapDoneDescription: Each shift below now points at the real TEF entry instead of the rejected shadow element.
